name: Geraldus and the Harper contact
deadline: Visit Danthelon's Dancing Axe before entering the Lower City
consequence: Geraldus is killed and the Harper basement encounter is lost.

name: Strange Ox delivery
trigger: Meeting the Strange Ox in Rivington
deadline: Carry it into the Lower City before entering without it

name: Counsellor Florrick's execution
trigger: Reading an Execution Notice or speaking to the enthralled Ravengard immediately after the coronation
deadline: Before completing the fifth qualifying long rest
consequence: Florrick is executed in Wyrm's Rock Prison.

name: Dolor targets Cora Highberry
trigger: Reading the murder list and approaching the Wine Festival, or entering the Murder Tribunal

name: Speak with Devella after saving Cora
trigger: Saving Cora before first meeting Devella
consequence: Devella disappears and her scenes and quest updates are lost.

name: Stop the Presses
trigger: Speaking to Ettvard Needle after the quest starts
consequence: The hostile article is printed and the party's reputation is tarnished.

name: Volo at Grey Harbour Docks
trigger: Approaching Churg Elvek's mob and the smokepowder cart
deadline: Before the burning trail detonates the eight Smokepowder Barrels during the encounter

name: Iron Throne collapse
trigger: Docking the submersible at the Iron Throne
consequence: Every party member and prisoner outside the submersible dies.

name: Morphic Pool final lockout
trigger: Using the skiff at the Morphic Pool Dock
deadline: Finish all city and camp preparation first
consequence: Camp, storage, party swaps, Withers, respecs, ordinary long rests, and all city content become unavailable.
